title.zh: 复盘这一次海洋心情安排

paragraphs.zh: 复盘时，先写“今天只选一张图和一个标题”，再与“留两个标题以后再看”并排。圈出两版各自的结束点，比较哪种范围合此刻心情；可以改范围或不选。无需制作、计时或检查执行率，不把收尾评为勤奋、效率或更可靠，也不要求自己模仿鲨鱼持续行动。
paragraphs.en: For review, compare choosing one image and title today with keeping two titles for later. Mark each finish and compare its scope for this mood, with revision or neither available. Make nothing and measure no speed or execution rate. A finish is no diligence, efficiency or reliability score and requires no shark-like continual action.

paragraphs.zh: 可以一起问：“如果封面只需选一张图、一个标题，怎样写清今天的终点，又保留以后再看的版本？”各拟一句，再借另一海洋意象调整范围。可只想象、不制作、不展示、不回答或结束，不必提交真实材料。
paragraphs.en: Ask together: “If a cover needed one image and title, how would you state today’s finish while keeping a version for later?” Draft a line each and adjust its scope through another ocean image. Imagine without making, displaying, answering or submitting real material, and stop whenever preferred.

paragraphs.zh: 分享公开全文时不带答卷和计数。六个名字是编辑比喻，不是六种鱼、动物基因比例或人格类型；动物背景不验证题本。讨论具体安排，不给朋友、同事或家人分型，不收集隐私或评价缺席者，也不以选项次数比较能力、健康或社会价值。
paragraphs.en: Share the public guide without answers or counts. Six names are editorial metaphors rather than six fish, animal genetic proportions or personality types; animal background does not validate the bank. Discuss arrangements without typing friends, colleagues or family, collecting private information, labelling absent people or comparing ability, health or social worth through counts.

title.zh: 复盘这一次海洋心情安排

paragraphs.zh: 复盘时，给同一句虚构旁白各留有回应与暂未回应两版，再写一句自己仍喜欢图中什么。不要为得到回应反复猜最讨喜的说法，也不需要真的发消息。比较交流占多大一段，而非回复是否证明喜欢、温暖或社交魅力；同伴可不接话，你也可改成独自看图。
paragraphs.en: For review, keep reply and no-reply-yet versions of an invented caption, then state what you still like in the image. Seek no pleasing phrase to secure a reply and send no message. Compare the exchange’s size rather than replies as liking, warmth or charisma. A companion may decline, and you may prefer viewing alone.

paragraphs.zh: 可以一起问：“如果旁白暂时没有回复，怎样保留自己喜欢画面的部分，又让对方不必承担接话义务？”各拟一句，再借另一海洋意象调整范围。可只想象、不制作、不展示、不回答或结束，不必提交真实材料。
paragraphs.en: Ask together: “If a caption had no reply yet, how would you retain your enjoyment of the image without making someone responsible for continuing?” Draft a line each and adjust its scope through another ocean image. Imagine without making, displaying, answering or submitting real material, and stop whenever preferred.

title.zh: 复盘这一次海洋心情安排

paragraphs.zh: 复盘时，保持同一张主图，分别想象旁边留空与再添两卡，各写一句下一步想做什么。可以继续看、换活动或结束，不需停留指定分钟，也不把留白当减压或恢复注意的疗法。比较这次画面密度，不以慢看评智慧、情绪稳定或生活节奏，也不要求下一次仍选安静。
paragraphs.en: For review, keep the main image and imagine clear space beside it or two additional cards, then state what you would do next with each. Continue, switch or finish without a timed stay or blank space as stress or attention treatment. Compare this density without slow viewing as wisdom, emotional stability or a permanent pace.

paragraphs.zh: 可以一起问：“如果同一主图旁边可以留空或添两张卡，两版各让你想继续看什么，什么时候也可以结束？”各拟一句，再借另一海洋意象调整范围。可只想象、不制作、不展示、不回答或结束，不必提交真实材料。
paragraphs.en: Ask together: “If one main image had clear space or two extra cards beside it, what would each invite you to notice and when could either finish?” Draft a line each and adjust its scope through another ocean image. Imagine without making, displaying, answering or submitting real material, and stop whenever preferred.

title.zh: 复盘这一次海洋心情安排

paragraphs.zh: 复盘时，只移动一张虚构照片，保留其余图片和标题长度，给两版各起一句标题。记录哪一个连接改变了感觉，再决定留原版、新版、两版或停下。无需编辑软件或公开成品；不以版本多少证明创意、多任务能力、适应力或身份，也不把不再比较叫作失败。
paragraphs.en: For review, move one invented photo while keeping other images and title length, then title both versions. Note the connection that changes the feel and keep either, both or stop. Use no editing software or public product. Version count proves no creativity, multitasking, adaptability or identity, and ending comparison is no failure.

paragraphs.zh: 可以一起问：“如果只移动相册里一张图，标题会怎样跟着变化，又怎样保留原版而不无限加新版本？”各拟一句，再借另一海洋意象调整范围。可只想象、不制作、不展示、不回答或结束，不必提交真实材料。
paragraphs.en: Ask together: “If only one album image moved, how might its title change while retaining the original without endless new versions?” Draft a line each and adjust its scope through another ocean image. Imagine without making, displaying, answering or submitting real material, and stop whenever preferred.

title.zh: 复盘这一次海洋心情安排

paragraphs.zh: 复盘时，把“聊半小时”和“先回这一张图”两句放在同一虚构情境里，分别圈出按时间和按内容的范围。选哪句都可改，两个都不合也可不参加。无需发送话术或解释私事；比较本次想参与多少，不评关系健康、勇气、尊重程度或防御，也不把动物轮廓当升级争执的理由。
paragraphs.en: For review, place chatting for half an hour and replying to one image in the same invented scene, marking time-based and content-based scope. Revise either or decline if neither fits. Send no script and explain no private reasons. Compare participation without grading relationship health, courage, respect or defensiveness, or using an animal outline to escalate conflict.

paragraphs.zh: 可以一起问：“如果同一次照片闲聊可以按半小时或一张图收尾，你更想怎样表达范围，又怎样保留再商量的可能？”各拟一句，再借另一海洋意象调整范围。可只想象、不制作、不展示、不回答或结束，不必提交真实材料。
paragraphs.en: Ask together: “If a photo chat could end after half an hour or one image, how would you express the scope while leaving room to reconsider?” Draft a line each and adjust its scope through another ocean image. Imagine without making, displaying, answering or submitting real material, and stop whenever preferred.

title.zh: 复盘这一次海洋心情安排

paragraphs.zh: 复盘时，把虚构贴纸的名字说明分成只给自己的一句和愿公开的一句，标出愿分享的内容，而非寻找必须藏的秘密。可都不说、以后改口或与别人喜欢相同东西。无需真实日记、照片或发帖；比较解释范围，不评独立、孤独、韧性、亲疏，也不从深海发光推断人能自给自足。
paragraphs.en: For review, separate an invented sticker’s name into a private sentence and a brief introduction, marking what you wish to share rather than a secret you must keep. Say neither, revise later or enjoy the same thing as someone else. Use no diary, photos or posts. Compare explanatory scope without independence, loneliness, resilience or closeness, or deep-sea light as human self-sufficiency.

paragraphs.zh: 可以一起问：“如果一个贴纸名字只有自己懂，哪一句可以愿意分享，哪些仍能保留而不需证明兴趣独特？”各拟一句，再借另一海洋意象调整范围。可只想象、不制作、不展示、不回答或结束，不必提交真实材料。
paragraphs.en: Ask together: “If a sticker’s name made sense only to you, which sentence might you share and what could remain private without proving uniqueness?” Draft a line each and adjust its scope through another ocean image. Imagine without making, displaying, answering or submitting real material, and stop whenever preferred.
